objects.name: 20日短期波动不稳定程度
objects.scope: 国内三只宽基ETF相对510300.SS锚定ETF的每日收盘风险研究；共同样本；非交易触发

definition.formula: For r[t]=100*(C[t]/C[t-1]-1), v5[j]=sample_std(r[j-4:j],ddof=1). X[t]=sample_std(v5[t-19:t],ddof=1)/mean(v5[t-19:t]); mean<=1e-12 is missing.
definition.endpoints: Only t close and earlier for features. Outcome is max closing-price loss from t+1 through t+21, relative to t+1 close.
definition.direction: Risk-prediction direction determined by evaluation; no assumed trading direction
definition.transforms: Economic OHLC; simple returns in percentage points; no winsorization or candidate tuning

universe.eligibility: Four source ETFs scheduled; 510300.SS is source-only anchor and explicitly excluded. Three predicted ETFs share dates where all 18 baseline fields and all three candidates are finite.
universe.warmup: 252 synchronized contiguous known OHLC rows for target and anchor
universe.missing: Any target/anchor missing or unknown action resets both; candidate denominator/variance rules yield missing; no imputation
universe.quality_gate: Reuse qualify_top_panel source-only V01 economic OHLC/action reconstruction
universe.degrade: Historical arrival and action-history completeness not independently certified; no sector or overseas extrapolation

validation.method: Independent hand arithmetic, price-scale invariance, prefix and synchronized-gap checks, common-support and anchor-exclusion tests; six synthetic two-model rehearsals
validation.limitations: Definition and synthetic engineering evidence only; no real-label effectiveness claim or production approval

lifecycle.verification_scope: Research-only definition and synthetic engineering; real results pending
